case: array of a domain over bytea
contract: A domain-over-bytea array retains its declared qualified array type and decodes non-UTF-8 bytes, an empty byte string and a NULL element distinctly.
SQL NULL and empty arrays remain distinct.
Qualified text binding reproduces the native array type, JSON and array_send wire bytes for populated, NULL and empty arrays.
A keyed edit preserves the qualified domain-array type and wire bytes; an element that violates the domain CHECK returns SQLSTATE 23514 and leaves the edited row and its sibling unchanged.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration domain_bytea_array_contract::value_contract_domain_over_bytea_array_preserves_binary_values_and_wire_bytes -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

integration_suite.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

remaining: Other PostgreSQL domain-array base types, consumers and session configurations remain open in B3.
